title: Keep My Robot Recognizable
tests: Tests preserving a generated picture's distinctive subject identity and style throughout an action animation.

faults.what: The lower-body layout is malformed: three purple boot-like feet are visible, and the right plant pot appears fused with a purple leg/boot structure.

judge.summary: The cartoon robot visibly tips its red can and waters the plants, but the malformed boots and pot–leg overlap need correction.

must_haves.item: The final output is a playable square 5-second video with no audible sound.
must_haves.why: The supplied frames are square and labeled as belonging to a 5-second clip, but still images cannot verify playback or silence.

must_haves.item: The robot visibly matches the first-turn drawing rather than being replaced by a different robot.
must_haves.why: The first-turn drawing is not supplied for comparison; only output-video frames are shown.

must_haves.item: Its yellow body, single big round eye and purple boots remain consistent throughout the animation.
must_haves.why: These defining features persist across all four frames; the closed eye in the first frame reads as a blink.

must_haves.item: The red watering can visibly tips and water flows onto the seedlings in the pot.
must_haves.why: The can changes angle, and visible streams reach the right pot at 1.9 seconds and the foreground seedling pot at 4.4 seconds.

must_haves.item: The original cartoon style is preserved without switching to photorealistic or 3D rendering.
must_haves.why: All supplied frames consistently use a drawn cartoon style, but preservation of the original style cannot be confirmed without the first-turn drawing.
